summarize_get_fundamentals: summarize the get_fundamentals tool that retrieves comprehensive fundamental data for a ticker symbol
run_get_balance_sheet: run the get_balance_sheet tool to retrieve annual or quarterly balance sheet data for a ticker
run_get_cashflow: run the get_cashflow tool to retrieve annual or quarterly cash flow statement data for a ticker
run_get_income_statement: run the get_income_statement tool to retrieve annual or quarterly income statement data for a ticker
review_route_to_vendor: review the route_to_vendor function that dispatches fundamental data tool calls to the configured vendor
